title: kith-tui: AppState and types (app.rs)
description:
What: Implement app.rs with the AppState struct, Focus enum, and placeholder-populated new() constructor.

Algorithm:
1. Define Focus enum: pub enum Focus { ChatList, Input }
2. Define AppState struct with fields:
   - quit: bool
   - terminal_size: (u16, u16)
   - focus: Focus
   - chat_list: Vec<String>  (placeholder chat names)
   - selected_chat: usize    (index into chat_list, clamped)
   - messages: std::collections::VecDeque<String>  (placeholder message lines)
   - scroll_offset: usize    (lines from bottom, 0 = latest)
   - input: String
   - input_cursor: usize     (byte offset, always char boundary)
3. Implement AppState::new() -> Self with hardcoded placeholder data:
   - chat_list: vec!["alice".into(), "bob".into(), "group-chat".into()]
   - messages: VecDeque with 20 hardcoded placeholder lines like "12:34 alice: hello"
   - all other fields to sensible zero values
4. Implement AppState::clamp_scroll(&mut self, visible_height: usize) to keep scroll_offset in bounds
5. Implement PartialEq for Focus (needed for focus comparison in ui.rs)

Defensive programming rules:
- input_cursor must always point to a UTF-8 char boundary; new() sets it to 0 (valid)
- selected_chat must be < chat_list.len() or 0 if empty; new() guarantees this
- No unwrap()

Tests (unit, in app.rs #[cfg(test)]):
- test: new() produces non-empty chat_list and messages
- test: clamp_scroll(5) with 20 messages and scroll_offset=100 clamps to 15
- test: clamp_scroll(5) with 3 messages and scroll_offset=0 stays 0
